body.p: Claims 1-20 were pending in this application.
The Examiner required restriction to one of the following groups under 35 USC 121:
I. Claims 1-10, allegedly drawn to an air-permeable bedding system.
II. Claims 11-15, allegedly drawn to a computer-implemented method.
III. Claims 16-20, allegedly drawn to a computer-implemented method.
In response, Applicant elects Group I without traverse. Claims 1-10 encompass the elected group.

Thus, the restriction is no longer applicable. If the examiner believes for any reason that direct contact would help advance the prosecution of this case to allowance, the examiner is encouraged to telephone the undersigned at the number given below.

If extensions of time are necessary to prevent abandonment of this application, then such extensions are hereby petitioned under 37 CFR 1.136(a), and any fees required therefor are hereby authorized to be charged to our Deposit Account 19-2555.
